info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Insurance Claims Claims Adjusters-v1-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Adjuster Retrieval API allows users to access a comprehensive list of insurance claims assigned to specific claims adjusters. This endpoint facilitates the retrieval of relevant claims data, enabling adjusters and insurance personnel to manage claims effectively. Typical consumers of this API include insurance companies, claims management systems, and adjusters looking to streamline their workflow. By utilizing this API, users can enhance their operational efficiency, ensuring timely processing and resolution of claims.

get.summary: Retrieve claims associated with a specific adjuster.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a list of claims that have been assigned to a particular adjuster. The retrieved data can be useful for evaluating the adjuster's performance and managing claims effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve adjuster-related information for claims. The request follows the structure defined in the associated schema and allows for the specification of relevant parameters for the query.

200.description: The request was successful, and the adjuster data is returned.
